subject: create
title: Draw Your Own Story
objective: Create an original 3-part drawing story: beginning, middle, end.

story_beats.text: Tara opens a fresh page in her sketchbook. 'Every story has three parts: a BEGINNING, a MIDDLE, and an END. Today, YOU are the storyteller!'

interactions.prompt: Draw the BEGINNING: who is your story about?
Draw the MIDDLE: what happens to them?
Draw the END: how does it finish?

hint_sequence: Try any way you like — there is no wrong start.
Copy the example, then make it yours.
transfer_question: Tell your three-part story aloud to someone at home.

feedback.correct: What a story! Tara loves your ending — tell it to someone at home!
feedback.retry: Every drawing is a good drawing. Keep going!

off_screen: Tell your story to someone at home using your three drawings.
